Results.ReviewText:
So far working with this Weber grill has been great. The iron grates cook as well as any cast iron pan I have used. The grill is assembled in such a ways that it is very easy to clean after use. The controls work very well, allowing one to set a temperature appropriate for the food being cooked and maintain the temperature quite well. Starting the flame is easy and I enjoy not having to find a battery, or a match. There are only two downside for me so far First is a minor issue, the tool hooks are the side tables are a bit too thick of the tools I use. A more major issue is the tank scale. Muscling the tank into position is quite a task. There is limited space to grasp the bottle and trying to lift the full tank is a challenge. since the bottom has an opening for the battle to fall through, simply not using the scale is not an option without modifying the grill. 
Overall, I like this grill very much and enjoy cooking on it.
Results.Title: Well made and easy to clean

Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.
